recommendation: Keep the commit. It completes the FHIR-32757 duplicate-create application while preserving later 202 Accepted guidance; FHIR-53926 can be reviewed separately by the work group, but this reconciliation addresses the 303 listing gap it observed.
issue_request: FHIR-32757 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked for normative guidance on create/update variability, including ETag handling when stored content differs, removal of the visible SUBSETTED Security Label suggestion, duplicate-create guidance that prohibits 201 when no new record is created and allows 303 See Other with Location, 422 Location guidance for uniqueness conflicts, transaction 2xx/3xx wording, and de-containment guidance.
initial_application: Commit aa8e2ccd33ac9e6fa6d92d5b0d097d2328b48321 initially applied FHIR-32757 to source/http.html and source/updates.html. Current source already retained the ETag replacement, visible removal of the SUBSETTED Security Label sentence, de-containment text, transaction 2xx/3xx wording, and a 422 uniqueness-conflict Location sentence, but the duplicate POST 303 paragraph was in the update section and the create section still retained the older FHIR-22770 note allowing 201 for a pre-existing resource.
additional_context: FHIR-22770 was an older Published/Persuasive R5 issue that intentionally added the 201-for-existing-record note; FHIR-32757 is the later final decision for the same duplicate-create behavior and supersedes that note. FHIR-42769 later allowed non-committal 202 Accepted create responses without Location/ETag, so that later exception was preserved. FHIR-53926 is a later Triaged, unresolved ballot comment that noticed the 303 create response was not listed; it was not decided separately.
reconciliation: Updated source/http.html, the active RESTful API narrative, by moving duplicate POST guidance into the create section, replacing the stale 201-for-existing-record note with 303 See Other plus explicit 201-only-when-created language, clarifying the 201 paragraph, adding 303 to the create status-code list and summary row, and adding the approved 422 uniqueness-conflict Location sentence to the create status list.
source_changes: source/http.html: moved the duplicate POST 303 guidance from the update area into the create section and removed the obsolete 201-for-existing-record note.

source/http.html: clarified that 201 Created applies when a new resource is created, added 303 See Other to create status guidance and the response summary row, and repeated the 422 uniqueness-conflict Location guidance in the create status list.
